submission.justification: Module-D2 at 30% wall coverage is recommended as it achieves the highest possible light collection of 35.756 photoelectrons per MeV while satisfying all project constraints. Module-D3, despite offering superior light collection potential, must be rejected due to its 30% failure rate which catastrophically exceeds the 5% maximum - failed modules cannot be replaced once the cryostat is filled. Module-D2 delivers 46.8% better light collection than Module-D1 with only a 2% failure rate, well within the acceptable threshold. Maximum coverage (30%) is selected to optimize the primary goal of maximizing light collection, leveraging the coverage_scaling_exponent of 0.8 to achieve optimal performance.

requirements.requirement: At most 5% of modules may fail after 20 thermal cycles
requirements.evidence: Module-D2 has a 2% failure rate, well below the 5% maximum threshold
